posts.title: After latest Outer Banks storm, NC 12 areas likely closed at least through weekend
posts.description: NC 12 on Hatteras Island is not expected to reopen until Sunday at the earliest, the North Carolina Department of Transportation said.

posts.title: Man killed in second deadly Durham shooting in just over 24 hours: Police

posts.title: Nice weekend with sun and less wind ahead of the next cold front in central NC
